briefdescription.para: Implements staff management for one service entity type.

detaileddescription.para: In plain words, this file defines the class that actually carries out the three staff jobs declared in StaffControllerBase - adding a member, removing a member, and inviting a member by email. Unlike the service controllers, this class is not an EntityController, it inherits Controller for the low-level "add/remove staff" database helpers and writes the job logic itself. For each job it reads the request, asks the authorisation service (GateKeeper) whether the caller is allowed, and only then does something — run SQL or send an HTTP request to the email daemon.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: It is the concrete implementation behind the staff HTTP routes. The route layer calls these methods through StaffControllerBase (with a std::variant choosing the entity type); each call lands here, where permission is checked before any change is made. It calls into Controller for SQL, GateKeeper for permission decisions and the email daemon for invitations. Without it, there would be no code to add, remove or invite staff, and the staff interface would have nothing behind it.

CONCEPTS TO LEARN (for beginners):
std::shared_ptr (a smart pointer that shares ownership of an object): https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/memory/shared_ptr
Forward declarations (telling the compiler a type exists before defining it): https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/language/declarations
C++20 coroutines (functions that pause and resume with co_await/co_return): https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/language/coroutines
